task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York and the status of flight AA100, then get the weather forecast for New York and convert 15 degrees Celsius to Fahrenheit. After that, generate a weather alert card for New York and publish it to user u_alice_123's app with high priority, and also publish a lodging packet for a deluxe room at hotel h_123 starting November 1st to the same user.

user_input.query: Can you check the current time in New York, using the America/New_York timezone, and look up the status of flight AA100? After that, please get the weather forecast for New York and convert 15 degrees Celsius to Fahrenheit. Next, generate a weather alert card for New York and publish it to user u_alice_123 with high priority on their app. Finally, please publish a lodging packet to user u_alice_123 for a deluxe room at hotel h_123, checking in on 2024-11-01.
